pin.longFormSummary:
A bakery and cookie counter relocating into Tenjin Underground Mall, with two dated opening food bundles and conditional return-visit discounts.

October 8 operator announcement and live landlord branch page confirm October 23, 2026 opening at the new underground address. Old Fukuoka Tenjin branch closed October 12 for this relocation; this co-located Antique, Guilty’s and Nekoneko counter counts as one venue.
